normalization.aspect_policy: expand crop to target aspect ratio; never anisotropically stretch
normalization.runtime_scaling: none; 1 output pixel = 1 world pixel at ProcGenMap scale 1

procgen_contract.mask_policy: The explicit cell arrays in this package were generated once as an authoring aid from normalized visual alpha, then conservatively dilated by one 4-neighbor cell. Commit these arrays explicitly. Runtime MUST NOT infer collision, navigation, walkability, or placement masks from PNG alpha.
procgen_contract.default_semantics: All occupied hardstand cells are presentation-only walkable overlays in V1. If a perimeter is later judged gameplay-blocking, author solid cells only where existing terrain is already blocked/wall/ledge/drop. Never create collision from the image.

surface_family_budget.note: Do not let this family consume the existing Rocky Upland SURFACE quota. Recommended planner policy: add a family sub-cap of 2 hardstand stamps and raise total SURFACE capacity only as needed so Rocky Upland retains its existing allowance.
